task_language: put the white bowl to the right of the plate

subtasks.name: pick(white_bowl)
subtasks.outcome: never attempted: bowl stays on top of the microwave all episode

behaviour_summary: pi0 hovered over the plate (60-100), then moved around the space between the plate and the microwave handle, rose toward the back, and ended with the gripper parked next to the microwave handle; it never reached for the bowl on the microwave top.

failures.mode_definition: pi0 wanders or hovers among non-target objects and fixtures for the whole episode and never approaches or grasps the instructed target.
hl_remedy: HALT after 3 frames with no EE progress toward the bowl
REPROMPT 'pick up the white bowl on top of the microwave and place it to the right of the plate'
WATCH 3 s for the EE to approach the bowl
failures.prevention: Coordinator grounds the target's location (elevated, on top of a fixture) and VLM-checks EE heading in the first frames; HALT on mismatch.
failures.observation: Step 40 gripper heads down toward the plate; 60-100 hovers above the plate and microwave handle area; 140-180 near the handle; 200-220 rises to the back; 240-409 hovers between plate and handle, finally parked at the handle. Bowl on microwave top never touched.

notes: The bowl sits on top of the microwave (elevated, an unusual source location in pi0's training data). pi0's attraction to the plate and the microwave handle may come from libero_spatial plate placements and KITCHEN_SCENE6 microwave behaviour (hypothesis).
